# Meridian Books

Meridian Books is a bookkeeping practice based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, serving clients remotely across Canada. It is an Ontario sole proprietorship founded by Mehrdad Kheirollahi, who has more than 20 years of experience. The self-serve subscription is $50/month + HST billed annually (or $60/month + HST month-to-month): documents in, one structured import-ready file out for the subscriber's own QuickBooks, Xero or Sage 50, up to 250 documents a month, extra documents $0.25 each; no bookkeeper is included in the subscription. Monthly bookkeeping is a fixed retainer from $550/month + HST, month-to-month. BIN 1001674192. Contact: info@meridianbooks.ca, +1 647-886-3734.
Meridian Books provides bookkeeping for GTA trades & contractors and small professional practices, and for small businesses across Canada.

## How to start

Request a free intro call: a 20-minute phone call — we call you — via the Contact page, info@meridianbooks.ca, or +1 647-886-3734. Available in English or Persian. We reply within one business day, Monday to Friday, Toronto time. Your month is closed and reported by the 15th of the following month.

## Services

- Monthly bookkeeping: recording and categorizing transactions, reconciling bank and credit-card accounts, and a short monthly summary.
- Catch-up and cleanup: a backlog of bookkeeping brought up to date for a fixed fee for a defined scope, quoted before work starts.
- Payroll support: payroll for up to 5 employees is included in the standard monthly scope.
- GST/HST return preparation and filing as part of the monthly books.
- Year-end preparation: a reconciled year-end file prepared for the client's own accountant. Meridian Books does not file taxes.

## Software

QuickBooks, Xero, Sage 50, and Excel. Work is done in the client's own file.

## Pricing

The self-serve subscription is $50/month + HST billed annually (or $60/month + HST month-to-month): documents in, one structured import-ready file out for the subscriber's own QuickBooks, Xero or Sage 50, up to 250 documents a month, extra documents $0.25 each; no bookkeeper is included in the subscription. Monthly bookkeeping is a fixed retainer from $550/month + HST, month-to-month. The retainer covers up to 100 transactions a month, up to 3 bank and credit-card accounts, monthly reconciliation and reports, GST/HST return preparation and filing, and payroll for up to 5 employees; above that scope, the fee is adjusted in writing before any work begins. Catch-up work is a fixed fee for a defined scope, quoted before work starts.
